title: ML Heating — Full Observability
description: Full observability for the ML Heating control system.

panels.title: Learning confidence
panels.description: Thermal model learning confidence. >=3 = good parameters.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ml_heating_features")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ml_thermal_parameters")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["learning_confidence"]))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

panels.title: Latest benchmark context
panels.description: Most recent per-cycle benchmark snapshot incl. efficiency tag.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ml_heating_features")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ml_heating_shadow_benchmark")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["target_temp", "outdoor_temp", "ml_outlet_prediction", "heat_curve_outlet_actual", "energy_savings_pct"]))
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "target_temp", "outdoor_temp", "ml_outlet_prediction", "heat_curve_outlet_actual", "energy_savings_pct", "efficiency_category"])
